blurb: Berkley Riverfront is a vibrant green space along the Missouri River in Kansas City featuring a two-mile trail, picnic areas, an urban bouldering park, sand volleyball courts, and public art murals. It connects the city to the river with pedestrian and bicycle paths and offers various outdoor activities and cultural experiences. The park is accessible by public transit and has parking and bike facilities.
